name: gameobject-component-update-or-create
description: Updates a component by serialized property path, creating it when absent by default.

writeNonSerialized.description: When true, unresolved names write fields/properties via reflection, including non-serialized members.

properties.description: JSON object keyed by serialized property path or, with writeNonSerialized, reflected member name.

json.description: Alias for properties. May be an object or JSON object string.
